critique_audit.specificity_verdict: Product-specific Nordic Ember presentation with generated lantern media and gift-led offer logic.
baseline_findings: Seven uppercase eyebrow labels competed with the actual headings.
Ember-gold text fell below WCAG AA on warm light surfaces.
The recommended bundle used a halo-like double border and the mobile offer cards were visually dense.
No reduced-motion alternative or themed browser selection/focus treatment was present.

noticeable_above_fold_improvements.change: Removed visible eyebrow clutter and tightened the hero display scale and line-height.
Added a darker Ember ink token for readable accent text and focus states.
Made the recommended gift bundle easier to scan with a warm selected surface, tabular pricing and calmer borders.
Simplified the mobile benefit and offer rhythm while preserving all locked content.
Added one lantern-led arrival moment, themed focus/selection states and a reduced-motion alternative.

preserved: Proposal A prices, quantities, gifts and savings
approved generated gallery and below-fold media

findings.name: Low contrast text
findings.description: Text does not meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text). Increase the contrast between text and background.

findings.name: Overused font
findings.description: Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.

findings.name: Cream / beige palette
findings.description: A warm cream or beige page background has become the default "tasteful" AI surface, reached for by reflex. Choose a background that comes from a deliberate palette, not the safe warm off-white.

detector_false_positives: Cream palette is the owner-locked Nordic Ember background, not an inferred generic choice.
Arial is the owner-locked body face in brand-system.json.
The reported #85520f-on-#17251f pair does not occur in a rendered element: the header accent is on warm white and the footer accent inherits light footer text.
